title: The Era of Killer Robots Is Here

sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 七十年的太空探索。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60份超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最好的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用不同的起始词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one-pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢一锅出的食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来致力于帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 现在订阅可享受nytimes.com/subscribe上的特别优惠。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Natalie Kittrowa.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的娜塔莉·基特罗瓦。

sentences.en: And this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Outmanned and outgunned in what has become a war of attrition against Russia,
sentences.zh: 在与俄罗斯的消耗战中，由于人力和火力处于劣势，

sentences.en: Ukraine has looked for any way to overcome its vulnerabilities on the battlefield.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰一直在寻找任何方法来克服其在战场上的弱点。

sentences.en: That search has led to the emergence of killer robots.
sentences.zh: 这种探索导致了杀手机器人的出现。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Paul Moser on how Ukraine has become a Silicon Valley for autonomous weapons and how artificial intelligence is reshaping modern warfare.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事保罗·莫泽将讲述乌克兰如何成为自主武器的硅谷，以及人工智能如何重塑现代战争。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, July 9th.
sentences.zh: 今天是7月9日，星期二。

sentences.en: Paul, when we've talked on the show about the applications of advanced artificial intelligence, one of the scarier ideas has been that militaries around the world could use it
sentences.zh: 保罗，当我们在这个节目中谈论先进人工智能的应用时，一个比较可怕的想法是，世界各地的军队可能会利用它

sentences.en: to make autonomous killing machines, i.e. killer robots.
sentences.zh: 来制造自主杀戮机器，也就是杀手机器人。

sentences.en: Your reporting shows that this may already be happening.
sentences.zh: 你的报道显示，这种情况可能已经发生了。

sentences.en: Tell me about it.
sentences.zh: 跟我说说吧。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, you know, when I first got started on my reporting, you know, I thought this was the stuff of sci-fi.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，当我刚开始做报道时，我以为这只是科幻小说里的东西。

sentences.en: Like, you think about AI hunting and killing somebody, and you think of Terminator and, you know, Arnold Schwarzenegger hunting people as a robot.
sentences.zh: 就像你想到人工智能追踪并杀死某人时，你会想到《终结者》，想到阿诺·施瓦辛格作为一个机器人去猎杀人类。

sentences.en: Or you think of HAL in 2001, A Space Odyssey, an all-knowing robot that can kill people on a spaceship.
sentences.zh: 或者你会想到《2001太空漫游》里的哈尔，一个能在宇宙飞船上杀人的全知机器人。

sentences.en: But the thing is, the early versions of this technology that will get us there are already being developed.
sentences.zh: 但问题是，能让我们实现这一目标的早期技术版本已经在开发中了。

sentences.en: And they're being developed in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 而且它们正在乌克兰被开发出来。

sentences.en: And in some ways, Ukraine has become a nexus for the development of this type of autonomous military technology writ large.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，乌克兰已经成为这种自主军事技术发展的核心枢纽。

sentences.en: They're taking, basically, artificial intelligence and finding all kinds of new military applications for it.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上是在利用人工智能，并为其寻找各种新的军事应用。

sentences.en: Why has Ukraine become that nexus?
sentences.zh: 为什么乌克兰会成为这个枢纽？

sentences.en: So perhaps most importantly, they're outgunned.
sentences.zh: 也许最重要的是，他们的火力处于劣势。

sentences.en: Weapons don't necessarily come quickly or predictably from the United States or Europe.
sentences.zh: 武器并不一定能从美国或欧洲快速或可预测地运抵。

sentences.en: They have to reach to anything they can use to fight this war.
sentences.zh: 他们必须利用一切能用来打这场仗的东西。

sentences.en: And so they turn to consumer technology and emerging technologies like AI to build new effective weapons.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们转向消费技术和人工智能等新兴技术，以制造出有效的新型武器。

sentences.en: The second point is that they're outmanned.
sentences.zh: 第二点是他们的人力处于劣势。

sentences.en: And so as you're facing the prospect of defending all these trenches, and you just don't have as many people as the Russians have,
sentences.zh: 当你面临防守所有这些战壕的前景，而你的人数又没有俄罗斯人多时，

sentences.en: you need to come up with things that solve that problem.
sentences.zh: 你需要想出一些能解决这个问题的东西。

sentences.en: And what better than something like an automated machine gun or a drone?
sentences.zh: 还有什么比自动机枪或无人机更好的呢？

sentences.en: And then perhaps something people don't realize is that Ukraine has been a bit of a back office for the global technology industry for a long time.
sentences.zh: 此外，也许人们没有意识到的是，长期以来，乌克兰一直是全球科技行业的后勤基地。

sentences.en: Many of the apps you use every day were probably, in some part, coded by engineers in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 你每天使用的许多应用程序，可能在某种程度上都是由乌克兰的工程师编写的。

sentences.en: And so you have a lot of coders and a lot of skilled experts taking their abilities and saying,
sentences.zh: 所以你有大量的程序员和技术专家，他们运用自己的能力，心想，

sentences.en: well, now we need to turn from building a dating app to figuring out how to stop the Russians.
sentences.zh: 好吧，现在我们需要从开发约会软件转向研究如何阻止俄罗斯人。

sentences.en: And that means building these new weapons.
sentences.zh: 这意味着要制造这些新武器。

sentences.en: And then finally, extremely importantly, this is a war of attrition.
sentences.zh: 最后，极其重要的一点是，这是一场消耗战。

sentences.en: And so every day there's fighting going on.
sentences.zh: 所以每天都有战斗在进行。

sentences.en: And that means you have the ability to test these weapons each day and, you know, to use a Silicon Valley term, iterate on them, tweak them and make them better.
sentences.zh: 这意味着你有能力每天测试这些武器，并且，用硅谷的一个术语来说，对它们进行迭代、微调，让它们变得更好。

sentences.en: And so having what is effectively a sort of laboratory to experiment and find out ways to make AI ever more deadly really helps.
sentences.zh: 因此，拥有一个实际上相当于实验室的地方来实验并寻找让人工智能变得更致命的方法，真的很有帮助。

sentences.en: Yeah, it sounds like you kind of have all of these conditions that line up to make
sentences.zh: 是的，听起来你似乎具备了所有这些条件，使得

sentences.en: Ukraine a perfect incubator to build this type of technology.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰成为制造这类技术的完美孵化器。

sentences.en: I'm wondering, Paul, what this actually looks like on the ground.
sentences.zh: 保罗，我想知道这在实地到底是什么样子的。

sentences.en: What kind of weapons are we talking about here?
sentences.zh: 我们在这里谈论的是什么样的武器？

sentences.en: Yeah, so I went to Ukraine in May, met with all kinds of different tech startups and developers, troops who use this technology.
sentences.zh: 是的，我五月份去了乌克兰，见到了各种各样的科技初创公司、开发人员以及使用这些技术的士兵。

sentences.en: And perhaps the most startling moment, like, wasn't near the front lines or anything.
sentences.zh: 也许最令人吃惊的时刻，并不是在前线附近什么的。

sentences.en: It was actually in a park just outside of Kiev.
sentences.zh: 它实际上是在基辅郊外的一个公园里。

sentences.en: And a couple of guys in their 20s and one in their teens who started this company that makes autonomous drones pulled up on motorcycles.
sentences.zh: 几个20多岁的年轻人和一个十几岁的少年，他们创办了一家制造自主无人机的公司，骑着摩托车赶了过来。

sentences.en: They take me to a field and they unbox a tiny little drone, four rotors on it, kind of a smaller version of a typical drone you'd use to take pictures of your vacation
sentences.zh: 他们带我到一片空地，拆开了一个微型无人机的包装，上面有四个旋翼，有点像你用来拍度假照片的那种普通无人机的缩小版

sentences.en: or something like that.
sentences.zh: 或者类似的东西。

sentences.en: Maybe we can put the screen, like, somewhere where it will be not so much sun.
sentences.zh: 也许我们可以把屏幕放在阳光没那么强烈的地方。

sentences.en: And then they flip open this briefcase with a screen on it.
sentences.zh: 然后他们打开了这个带屏幕的公文包。

sentences.en: And what they explained they'd done is they took a tiny little mini circuit board, a little mini hobbyist computer.
sentences.zh: 他们解释说，他们所做的是拿了一个微型电路板，一台小型业余爱好者的电脑。

sentences.en: Here we have a Raspberry Pi plus a thermal camera.
sentences.zh: 这里我们有一个树莓派加上一个热成像仪。

sentences.en: And put software on it that allows that tiny drone to follow a tank, a piece of artillery, or even a human, and eventually smash into it.
sentences.zh: 并在上面安装了软件，让那个微型无人机能够跟踪坦克、火炮，甚至是一个人，并最终撞向它。

sentences.en: And so the idea is if you have a shell on the bottom of it, it becomes something of a missile.
sentences.zh: 所以想法是，如果你在它底部装上一枚炮弹，它就变成了一种导弹。

sentences.en: I had heard of this before, but I hadn't seen it.
sentences.zh: 我之前听说过这个，但我没见过。

sentences.en: And so they said, well, you know, we're going to show you.
sentences.zh: 所以他们说，好吧，你知道，我们要演示给你看。

sentences.en: And so the CEO then flips on his motorcycle helmet,
sentences.zh: 于是首席执行官戴上他的摩托车头盔，

sentences.en: revs the engine a few times, and rips off down this dirt road as a target.
sentences.zh: 猛踩了几下油门，沿着这条土路飞驰而去，作为目标。

sentences.en: And one of the teammates launches the drone, and it's hovering above.
sentences.zh: 其中一名队员发射了无人机，它悬停在上方。

sentences.en: And then what you kind of see is that he centers the crosshairs on the motorcycle.
sentences.zh: 然后你看到的是，他将十字准线对准了摩托车。

sentences.en: And at that point, the machine takes over from the human.
sentences.zh: 就在那一刻，机器从人类手中接管了控制权。

sentences.en: And so the drone starts sort of stalking the motorcycle, and it's getting closer and closer.
sentences.zh: 于是无人机开始跟踪摩托车，并且越来越近。

sentences.en: And on the screen, you can see it.
sentences.zh: 在屏幕上，你可以看到它。

sentences.en: You know, it's lining up to swoop in.
sentences.zh: 你知道，它正在排成一线准备俯冲。

sentences.en: And his friends are crying out,
sentences.zh: 他的朋友们在大喊，

sentences.en: Go faster, go faster, you're screwed.
sentences.zh: 快点，快点，你死定了。

sentences.en: Oh my God, you're done.
sentences.zh: 天哪，你完了。

sentences.en: It's basically not more than a couple of feet away from him.
sentences.zh: 它基本上离他只有几英尺远。

sentences.en: Okay, it was really close.
sentences.zh: 好吧，真的很近。

sentences.en: And they hit a button and turn off the autonomy, and the drone flies back up into the air, and they're laughing.
sentences.zh: 他们按下一个按钮关闭了自动模式，无人机飞回空中，他们笑了起来。

sentences.en: And it's a funny moment because they were able to run down their CEO.
sentences.zh: 这是一个有趣的时刻，因为他们能够追上他们的首席执行官。

sentences.en: But the darker reality of it is that if this was an armed drone with a shell, and they hadn't hit that button at the end, their CEO would be a goner.
sentences.zh: 但更黑暗的现实是，如果这是一架装有炮弹的武装无人机，而他们最后没有按下那个按钮，他们的首席执行官就没命了。

sentences.en: And this is the technology that is already being used on the Ukrainian front lines to hit Russian targets.
sentences.zh: 这就是已经在乌克兰前线用于打击俄罗斯目标的这项技术。

sentences.en: It's kind of amazing.
sentences.zh: 这真是太神奇了。

sentences.en: What you're seeing is the computer takeover for the young startup guy in tracking down and targeting his CEO as he's swerving on his motorcycle.
sentences.zh: 你所看到的是电脑接管了那个年轻的创业者，在他骑着摩托车转弯时追踪并锁定了他。

sentences.en: And that's why this technology is so powerful, right?
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么这项技术如此强大，对吧？

sentences.en: This is not a remote-controlled drone.
sentences.zh: 这不是一架遥控无人机。

sentences.en: This is a drone powered by artificial intelligence that's making judgments on its own.
sentences.zh: 这是一架由人工智能驱动的无人机，它在自行做出判断。

sentences.en: Yeah, and I think what's important to realize about these guys is, you know, they're not doing something that miraculous.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为关于这些人，重要的是要意识到，你知道，他们并没有做什么奇迹般的事情。

sentences.en: What they're doing is they're taking basic code that is around, combined it with some new data from the war, and made it into something entirely different, which is a weapon.
sentences.zh: 他们所做的是采用现有的基础代码，结合战争中的一些新数据，将其变成了完全不同的东西，即武器。

sentences.en: And what this automation system adds to it is one of the great protections against these tiny types of drones is radio jamming.
sentences.zh: 而这个自动化系统增加的是，针对这些微型无人机的一大防御手段是无线电干扰。

sentences.en: And so if you can break the signal between pilot and drone, you can stop that drone from swooping in on your expensive weapon system.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你能切断飞行员和无人机之间的信号，你就能阻止那架无人机俯冲向你昂贵的武器系统。

sentences.en: But what this does is it doesn't matter what the pilot sees.
sentences.zh: 但这所做的是，飞行员看到什么并不重要。

sentences.en: Once they hit that lock with the help of this AI software, it will keep going.
sentences.zh: 一旦他们在这款人工智能软件的帮助下锁定了目标，它就会继续前进。

sentences.en: And so you all of a sudden are completely helpless to stop it unless you shoot it out of the sky.
sentences.zh: 所以你突然之间完全无力阻止它，除非你把它从空中击落。

sentences.en: It's kind of insane.
sentences.zh: 这简直太疯狂了。

sentences.en: I mean, we're talking about basically autonomous kamikaze drones.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们谈论的基本上是自主神风特攻队无人机。

sentences.en: Tell me about the other forms of AI that you saw.
sentences.zh: 跟我说说你看到的其他形式的人工智能。

sentences.en: Yeah, so if you imagine that single kamikaze drone, the next step is to make a swarm of those kamikaze drones.
sentences.zh: 是的，如果你想象那架单一的神风特攻队无人机，下一步就是制造一群那样的神风特攻队无人机。

sentences.en: And so there are a few companies who are building swarms of drones.
sentences.zh: 所以有几家公司正在制造无人机群。

sentences.en: And so what they're testing now is you have a single four-rotor drone that watches over the battlefield, but then it has its own little pack of kamikaze drones.
sentences.zh: 他们现在正在测试的是，你有一架四旋翼无人机在战场上空监视，但它有自己的一群神风特攻队无人机。

sentences.en: And it can choose a target and identify a target.
sentences.zh: 它可以选择目标并识别目标。

sentences.en: And, you know, it's constantly searching with its camera and it sees a tank.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，它一直在用摄像头搜索，然后它看到了坦克。

sentences.en: And it can then dispatch one of those drones to go in for a hit.
sentences.zh: 然后它可以派遣其中一架无人机去进行打击。

sentences.en: And one of the companies I spoke to called Swarmer recently tested that technology and hit a target 60 kilometers away.
sentences.zh: 我采访过的一家名为Swarmer的公司最近测试了这项技术，并击中了60公里外的目标。

sentences.en: So, you know, this is, again, not a very expensive thing.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，这再次说明，这不是什么非常昂贵的东西。

sentences.en: This is hardware that costs thousands of dollars and they're hitting weapon systems 60 kilometers away with incredible precision.
sentences.zh: 这是成本仅几千美元的硬件，他们正以惊人的精度击中60公里外的武器系统。

sentences.en: Another thing that is emerging is a sort of autonomous machine gun turret.
sentences.zh: 另一个正在出现的是一种自主机枪塔。

sentences.en: And so what this uses is computer vision that, you know, you would have on a lot of surveillance cameras or even on your iPhone,
sentences.zh: 它使用的是计算机视觉，你知道，你在许多监控摄像头甚至你的iPhone上都会有的那种，

sentences.en: you know, your smartphone, it will sort of circle a human and identify it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你的智能手机，它会圈出一个人并识别它。

sentences.en: So you take similar technology and you put it on a machine gun and that machine gun can then automatically see targets as they move.
sentences.zh: 所以你采用类似的技术并把它放在机枪上，那挺机枪就可以在目标移动时自动看到它们。

sentences.en: And then all it takes is a human to press the trigger.
sentences.zh: 然后只需要人类按下扳机即可。

sentences.en: And it's already sort of being tested right now.
sentences.zh: 它现在已经在进行某种测试了。

sentences.en: Some of it's already, you know, achieving kills and taking out targets.
sentences.zh: 其中一些已经，你知道，取得了杀伤并消灭了目标。

sentences.en: Paul, did you see the automated machine gun in action?
sentences.zh: 保罗，你亲眼看到自动机枪在行动了吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I did.
sentences.zh: 是的，我看到了。

sentences.en: And the story of it is actually fascinating.
sentences.zh: 关于它的故事实际上非常引人入胜。

sentences.en: And it kind of indicates why Ukraine is a place where these weapon systems are emerging.
sentences.zh: 它在某种程度上表明了为什么乌克兰是这些武器系统出现的地方。

sentences.en: So we went to a range and met a commander of a battalion called Da Vinci Wolves.
sentences.zh: 我们去了一个靶场，见到了一个名为“达芬奇狼”营的指挥官。

sentences.en: And Da Vinci Wolves are very well known in Ukraine for their experimentation with weapon systeMs.
sentences.zh: “达芬奇狼”在乌克兰以其对武器系统的实验而闻名。

sentences.en: And the commander we met, Oleksandr Yabchanka, you know, really looks the part of the Ukrainian community as this Cossack haircut and a bushy mustache.
sentences.zh: 我们见到的指挥官奥列克桑德·亚布昌卡，你知道，看起来真的很像乌克兰社区的一员，留着哥萨克发型和浓密的胡子。

sentences.en: And he was very excited about the gun.
sentences.zh: 他对这把枪非常兴奋。

sentences.en: He actually named his dog after the gun.
sentences.zh: 他甚至用这把枪的名字给他的狗命名。

sentences.en: And the reason he's so excited is because he helped create parts of the gun.
sentences.zh: 他之所以如此兴奋，是因为他参与制造了这把枪的部分零件。

sentences.en: He's helped innovate it.
sentences.zh: 他参与了创新。

sentences.en: And, you know, unlike the engineers that we were seeing in Kiev, he's a soldier.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，与我们在基辅看到的工程师不同，他是一名士兵。

sentences.en: So he's using this technology on the front and he's sort of the eyes for a lot of these companies.
sentences.zh: 所以他在前线使用这项技术，他算是很多这些公司的眼睛。

sentences.en: And he gives feedback to them about how it's working and what they need and so on.
sentences.zh: 他向他们提供关于它如何工作、他们需要什么等等的反馈。

sentences.en: And so he told me this amazing story.
sentences.zh: 所以他告诉我这个惊人的故事。

sentences.en: He was fighting in Bakhmut, a city in eastern Ukraine that the Russians were trying very hard to take over.
sentences.zh: 他当时在巴赫穆特作战，那是乌克兰东部的一座城市，俄罗斯人正极力想要占领它。

sentences.en: And his unit was tasked with defending the only road in and out of the city.
sentences.zh: 他的部队的任务是守卫进出该市的唯一道路。

sentences.en: And they kept having this problem, which was that their machine gunners were just constantly a target.
sentences.zh: 他们一直遇到这个问题，那就是他们的机枪手总是成为目标。

sentences.en: A machine gun is a big, heavy gun that can't easily be moved.
sentences.zh: 机枪是一种笨重的大枪，不容易移动。

sentences.en: You need to man it at all times.
sentences.zh: 你需要时刻有人操作它。

sentences.en: So he did what I think a lot of us do these days.
sentences.zh: 所以他做了我想我们很多人现在都会做的事情。

sentences.en: He went online and tried to find a solution.
sentences.zh: 他上网试图寻找解决方案。

sentences.en: And he ended up asking on Facebook if anybody had an idea.
sentences.zh: 最后他在Facebook上询问是否有人有主意。

sentences.en: And in just a few months, he had a working prototype in his hands from a company called Robineers.
sentences.zh: 仅仅几个月后，他就从一家名为Robineers的公司手中拿到了一个可用的原型机。

sentences.en: And what the gun does is it uses cameras and what is effectively a video game console, a sort of portable thing that looks like a Nintendo Switch.
sentences.zh: 这把枪的作用是使用摄像头和实际上是一个视频游戏机的东西，一种看起来像任天堂Switch的便携式设备。

sentences.en: And it can automatically identify targets as they come over the horizon or appear.
sentences.zh: 当目标出现在地平线上或出现时，它可以自动识别它们。

sentences.en: And then it kind of automatically aiMs.
sentences.zh: 然后它会自动瞄准。

sentences.en: And all the soldier has to do is press the button and shoot.
sentences.zh: 士兵所要做的就是按下按钮并射击。

sentences.en: It sounds honestly quite terrifying.
sentences.zh: 老实说，这听起来相当可怕。

sentences.en: Automated gun crowdsourced on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 在Facebook上众包出来的自动枪。

sentences.en: The whole thing sounds really outlandish, if I'm honeSt.
sentences.zh: 说实话，整件事听起来真的很离谱。

sentences.en: Yeah, but it solved his unit's probleMs.
sentences.zh: 是的，但它解决了他们部队的问题。

sentences.en: He said, it was great.
sentences.zh: 他说，这太棒了。

sentences.en: We could sit back in the trench, drink coffee, smoke cigarettes and shoot Russians.
sentences.zh: 我们可以坐在战壕里，喝着咖啡，抽着烟，射杀俄国人。

sentences.en: And it solved this problem using very basic technology that's very powerful, but that lives in your smartphone and lives on your video game systems
sentences.zh: 它利用了非常基础但功能强大的技术，这些技术存在于你的智能手机和电子游戏系统中，

sentences.en: and is pretty easily able to be created with artificial intelligence.
sentences.zh: 而且很容易通过人工智能创造出来。

sentences.en: Paul, you've said this technology has been quite effective in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 保罗，你说过这项技术在乌克兰非常有效。

sentences.en: But just to express a dose of my skepticism here, I think many of us interact with AI through ChatGPT or Gemini,
sentences.zh: 但我还是要表达一下我的怀疑，我认为我们很多人是通过 ChatGPT 或 Gemini 与人工智能互动的，

sentences.en: and we've seen the kind of hilariously bad answers those systems can produce.
sentences.zh: 我们也见识过这些系统能给出多么荒谬可笑的错误答案。

sentences.en: Like, we can't even depend on AI to solve a crossword puzzle.
sentences.zh: 比如，我们甚至不能指望人工智能来解填字游戏。

sentences.en: I'm just wondering, how can Ukrainians rely on this technology for much higher stakes stuff?
sentences.zh: 我只是在想，乌克兰人怎么能在这类风险高得多的事情上依赖这项技术呢？

sentences.en: I mean, hitting the right targets in war.
sentences.zh: 我是说，在战争中精准打击目标。

sentences.en: Are they finding that their AI is making mistakes?
sentences.zh: 他们有没有发现人工智能在犯错？

sentences.en: We don't really know the answer to that.
sentences.zh: 我们并不真正知道答案。

sentences.en: We do know that the systems work pretty well, and part of the point is that they're supposed to be cheap, so they don't always have to work.
sentences.zh: 我们确实知道这些系统运行得相当不错，而且重点之一是它们应该很便宜，所以它们不必总是完美运行。

sentences.en: If they work 80% of the time and they're cheap, that's okay.
sentences.zh: 如果它们有 80% 的时间能正常工作，而且成本低廉，那就没问题。

sentences.en: I will say that another reason why they want the human in the loop who can turn off the AI is that they're afraid of friendly fire and hitting the wrong target.
sentences.zh: 我得说，他们希望有人类参与其中并能随时关闭人工智能的另一个原因是，他们担心误伤友军和击中错误目标。

sentences.en: There's an ethical consideration, but there's also just a very practical one that this tech could go wrong and go at the wrong person or identify the wrong thing,
sentences.zh: 这不仅是伦理考量，也是非常实际的考量，因为这项技术可能会出错，可能会攻击错误的人或识别错误的目标，

sentences.en: and they need to be able to turn it off.
sentences.zh: 所以他们需要有能力将其关闭。

sentences.en: So there are still humans in the mix, but even with this bad technology, perhaps it's even scarier, it's super simple to just take the human out of the mix.
sentences.zh: 因此，目前仍有人类参与其中，但即使是这种糟糕的技术，或许更可怕的是，将人类排除在外简直太简单了。

sentences.en: And how close are we to that?
sentences.zh: 我们离那一步还有多远？

sentences.en: I mean, is Ukraine's military contemplating a scenario where the humans really go away and the machines and their judgments are entirely responsible for killing?
sentences.zh: 我是说，乌克兰军方是否在考虑一种人类真正退出，由机器及其判断完全负责杀戮的场景？

sentences.en: So that was a question I posed to everyone working on this stuff.
sentences.zh: 这是我向所有从事这项工作的人提出的一个问题。

sentences.en: And, you know, the general answer is a no, that the human will stay in the loop for the foreseeable future.
sentences.zh: 你知道，普遍的回答是否定的，即在可预见的未来，人类仍将参与其中。

sentences.en: But people had different takes on it, and one guy who had a particularly interesting answer was an executive at the firm that made that automated machine gun, Robineers.
sentences.zh: 但人们对此有不同的看法，其中一个人的回答特别有趣，他是制造那款自动机枪的公司 Robineers 的高管。

sentences.en: His name is Anton Skripnik, and I met him at his offices in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 他叫安东·斯克里普尼克，我在乌克兰的办公室里见到了他。

sentences.en: So, you know, realistically, the pace that we're seeing, when do you think we're going to start seeing the first automated kind of killing?
sentences.zh: 那么，以我们目前看到的节奏，你认为我们什么时候会开始看到第一种自动杀戮？

sentences.en: And when I asked him how or when the first automated killing on the front lines might occur...
sentences.zh: 当我问他前线何时或如何可能发生第一次自动杀戮时……

sentences.en: You know, he said it probably, honestly, has already happened.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他说老实说，这可能已经发生了。

sentences.en: He had no way of knowing.
sentences.zh: 他无从知晓。

sentences.en: You know, he wasn't sure, but...
sentences.zh: 你知道，他不确定，但是……

sentences.en: People very often just do something to survive, to complete a mission without, like, sharing information.
sentences.zh: 人们为了生存、为了完成任务，往往会直接采取行动，而不去分享信息。

sentences.en: And this is, like, not bad.
sentences.zh: 这其实并不算坏事。

sentences.en: You know, in a fast-paced, high-stress environment, on the front where life and death are oftentimes a matter of an instant decision,
sentences.zh: 你知道，在快节奏、高压力的前线环境中，生死往往取决于瞬间的决定，

sentences.en: whether or not a soldier flipped a switch that allowed something to just sort of go fully automated in this way or autonomous is very possible.
sentences.zh: 士兵是否按下开关，让某种东西以这种方式完全自动化或自主运行，是非常有可能的。

sentences.en: Is there any thought of changing that, or is that something that you guys are sort of stand by?
sentences.zh: 有没有考虑过改变这一点，还是说你们坚持这样做？

sentences.en: And so I asked him, OK, but you guys aren't doing this.
sentences.zh: 所以我问他，好吧，但你们并没有这样做。

sentences.en: Like, there is no, not a single request about, like, having that.
sentences.zh: 就像，没有任何人提出过那样的要求。

sentences.en: He said, no, for us, you have to hit this trigger every time the gun sees a target so that it shoots.
sentences.zh: 他说，不，对我们来说，每当枪支发现目标时，你都必须扣动扳机，它才会射击。

sentences.en: How long would it take you to do it if you wanted to?
sentences.zh: 如果你想做的话，需要多久？

sentences.en: And I said, so, OK, but if you wanted to make it fully autonomous, how long would that take?
sentences.zh: 我说，好吧，但如果你想让它完全自主，那需要多久？

sentences.en: Tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天。

sentences.en: Tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天。

sentences.en: Because today is already, like...
sentences.zh: 因为今天其实已经……

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, I've taken two hours of your time.
sentences.zh: 是啊，是啊，我已经占用了你两个小时的时间了。

sentences.en: So basically no time at all.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上不需要任何时间。

sentences.en: It's a matter of a few lines of code because these things are already effectively doing the auto-targeting.
sentences.zh: 这只是几行代码的问题，因为这些东西实际上已经在进行自动瞄准了。

sentences.en: It just has the human pulling the trigger.
sentences.zh: 只是现在由人类来扣动扳机。

sentences.en: So to make the computer pull the trigger is almost so easy it's trivial.
sentences.zh: 所以让电脑来扣动扳机几乎太容易了，简直微不足道。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So what Anton is saying essentially is that he already has the technology to create a robot that makes the decision to kill on its own.
sentences.zh: 所以安东本质上是在说，他已经拥有了制造一种能自主决定杀戮的机器人的技术。

sentences.en: There's a human operator for now, but that's not a necessity.
sentences.zh: 目前还有人类操作员，但这并非必要。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And, you know, his answer really hit home for me because I still, I think, even sitting there had thought that this was the stuff of science fiction.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他的回答真的触动了我，因为即使坐在那里，我仍然认为这只是科幻小说里的东西。

sentences.en: But what I realized at that moment is that, you know, the era of the killer robot is already upon us.
sentences.zh: 但在那一刻我意识到，杀人机器人的时代已经来临了。

sentences.en: We're already here.
sentences.zh: 我们已经身处其中了。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你刚才听到的人那样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 立即开始游戏。

sentences.en: Paul, you started to get into the potential moral questions raised by a world where robots need no human input at all to make decisions about killing people.
sentences.zh: 保罗，你开始谈到在一个机器人完全不需要人类输入就能做出杀人决定的世界里所引发的潜在道德问题。

sentences.en: Let's talk about those questions.
sentences.zh: 让我们谈谈这些问题。

sentences.en: So I guess the first big consideration is who has access to this and where it will spread.
sentences.zh: 我想第一个重大考量是谁能接触到这些技术，以及它将传播到哪里。

sentences.en: And, you know, the first group that does is powerful countries, right?
sentences.zh: 你知道，第一批掌握它的群体是强大的国家，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, the United States is developing swarms of drones that can accompany its fighter jets.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，美国正在开发可以伴随战斗机飞行的无人机群。

sentences.en: Other major military powers in Europe and China, for instance, also are developing this kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 欧洲和中国的其他主要军事大国也在开发这类东西。

sentences.en: But it's also not just those guys.
sentences.zh: 但不仅仅是他们。

sentences.en: You know, Ukraine, for instance, has channels where it's been sharing tips on drone warfare.
sentences.zh: 你知道，例如乌克兰就有分享无人机作战技巧的渠道。

sentences.en: You know, we did a story earlier in the year out of Myanmar where we found Burmese drone pilots were training on Ukrainian software that taught them to use kamikaze drones.
sentences.zh: 你知道，今年早些时候我们报道过缅甸，我们发现缅甸的无人机飞行员正在使用乌克兰软件进行训练，教他们使用自杀式无人机。

sentences.en: And so the question becomes how long until these sorts of automated targeting softwares are shared?
sentences.zh: 所以问题变成了，这些自动瞄准软件还需要多久才会传播开来？

sentences.en: And perhaps what's maybe scarier is that Russia also is developing very similar solutions to the Ukrainians.
sentences.zh: 或许更可怕的是，俄罗斯也在开发与乌克兰人非常相似的解决方案。

sentences.en: And so who will they share it with?
sentences.zh: 那么他们会与谁分享呢？

sentences.en: Will they share it with North Korea, Iran, certain fighters in Sudan?
sentences.zh: 他们会与朝鲜、伊朗、苏丹的某些武装人员分享吗？

sentences.en: So the point is it's very easy to spread software.
sentences.zh: 所以重点是，软件传播起来非常容易。

sentences.en: I mean, this isn't even a piece of hardware.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这甚至不是硬件。

sentences.en: This is just something that plugs into a piece of hardware.
sentences.zh: 这只是插入硬件的东西。

sentences.en: You can send it over an email.
sentences.zh: 你可以通过电子邮件发送它。

sentences.en: And the guys that we talked to in the field who are flying the drones,
sentences.zh: 而我们采访的那些在前线操作无人机的人，

sentences.en: one of the problems they had with their technology when they showed it to the Ukrainian military is that it wasn't encrypted.
sentences.zh: 他们向乌克兰军方展示技术时遇到的问题之一是它没有加密。

sentences.en: So the Ukrainians were afraid that if their drone crashed behind enemy lines without blowing up, the Russians could take the little mini computer,
sentences.zh: 所以乌克兰人担心，如果他们的无人机在敌后坠毁而没有爆炸，俄国人可能会拿走那个小微型电脑，

sentences.en: download the code and use it to build their own system and hit the Ukrainians.
sentences.zh: 下载代码并用它来构建自己的系统，然后打击乌克兰人。

sentences.en: So software spreads incredibly fast and incredibly easily.
sentences.zh: 所以软件传播的速度极快，也极其容易。

sentences.en: And it's going to be extremely hard once these solutions are developed to stop them from going almost anywhere.
sentences.zh: 一旦这些解决方案被开发出来，想要阻止它们流向任何地方将变得极其困难。

sentences.en: It's not hard to imagine a dark website that allows you to sell all manner of autonomous drone attack systeMs.
sentences.zh: 不难想象会有一个暗网网站，让你出售各种各样的自主无人机攻击系统。

sentences.en: There was one U.S.
sentences.zh: 有一位美国官员曾与我交谈，他对这背后的恐怖主义影响感到非常担忧。

sentences.en: official I was speaking with who has huge concerns about the terrorism implications of this.
sentences.zh: 所以，我的意思是，这并不难想象。

sentences.en: So, I mean, it's not hard to imagine.
sentences.zh: 比如，拿一架无人机来说。

sentences.en: I mean, take a drone, for example.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你可以从 20 或 30 英里外飞入某样东西，这变得极难防御。

sentences.en: You know, you could fly something in from 20, 30 miles away and becomes extremely difficult to defend againSt.
sentences.zh: 这显然引发了很多问题，我必须假设伦理学家和人权官员正在提出其中的一些问题。

sentences.en: That raises a lot of questions, obviously, and I have to assume that ethicists and human rights officials are asking some of them.
sentences.zh: 例如，有没有办法监管人工智能武器？

sentences.en: For example, is there any way to regulate AI weapons?
sentences.zh: 我们能限制它们的使用吗？

sentences.en: Can we put limits on their use?
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 所以这在联合国专家小组中已经争论多年了。

sentences.en: So this is something that's been debated, you know, in the U.N.
sentences.zh: 但我们从未真正达成任何具体的东西，部分原因是各国已经在进行开发这些东西的军备竞赛。

sentences.en: by panels of experts for years.
sentences.zh: 每当有人提出某种规则时，它就会被否决，如果不是被美国否决，就是被中国、俄罗斯或欧洲其他国家否决。

sentences.en: But we never really get to anything particularly concrete, in part because countries are already in an arms race to develop these things.
sentences.zh: 但伦理学家们支持一些基本原则，比如保持人类参与其中，以便人类做出最终决定，

sentences.en: And every time anybody proposes some kind of a rule, it's vetoed, if not by the United States, by China, by Russia, by other countries in Europe.
sentences.zh: 即使是在有自动瞄准的情况下。

sentences.en: But there are some basic principles that ethicists sort of rally behind, things like keeping a human in the loop so that the human makes the ultimate decision,
sentences.zh: 这就是乌克兰人所坚持的底线。

sentences.en: even if there's automated targeting going on.
sentences.zh: 但同样，真的没有什么能阻止这一切流向任何它想去的地方。

sentences.en: And that's the sort of line the Ukrainians are standing behind.
sentences.zh: 老实说，感觉我们已经在朝着那个方向发展了。

sentences.en: But again, there's really not much out there to stop any of this from going wherever it wants to go.
sentences.zh: 保罗，一直听你讲到现在，我一直在想我们应该如何看待这种由软件决定谁生谁死的想法。

sentences.en: And honestly, it feels like we're already heading in that direction.
sentences.zh: 因为一方面，我不得不说机器人猎杀人类的想法确实令人恐惧。

sentences.en: Paul, in listening to you this whole time, I've been wondering how we should think about this idea of software making the decision about who lives and dies.
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，人类在战争中也并非以克制著称。

sentences.en: Because on the one hand, I have to say the idea of robots hunting down humans is truly frightening.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，现在我们正在目睹乌克兰和加沙的两场战争，人类主导的军事行动已经杀死了数万人，其中许多是平民。

sentences.en: But on the other hand, it's not as if humans are known for their restraint in war.
sentences.zh: 所以我很好奇，在你的报道中，你是否认为这项技术在某种程度上是一种更好或更精确的战争形式？

sentences.en: I mean, right now we're witnessing two wars in Ukraine and in Gaza where human-led military campaigns have killed tens of thousands of people, many of them civilians.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为有趣的是，我采访的一些构建这项技术的科技人员确实提出了这个观点。

sentences.en: And so I'm wondering, in your reporting, have you come to think of this technology as in any way better or a more precise form of warfare?
sentences.zh: 他们的逻辑大致是，如果我们有机器人对抗机器人，人类就不会死亡。

sentences.en: Yeah, so I think what was interesting is some of the technologists building this that I spoke with did make this case.
sentences.zh: 如果我们能在软件中加入规则，比如，你知道，规定这种武器不能杀害儿童。

sentences.en: And their logic goes something like, if we have robots fighting robots, humans aren't dying.
sentences.zh: 我们可以阻止它做一些可能由非常糟糕的人类会做的事情。

sentences.en: If we can put rules inside the software, no, you know, say children will be killed by this weapon.
sentences.zh: 你甚至可以创造出像前线那样的空间，没有人能踏足，你知道，因为武器太致命了，两侧各四公里内都无人。

sentences.en: We can prevent it from doing certain things that maybe a really bad human would do.
sentences.zh: 那么你该如何向前推进呢？

sentences.en: And you could maybe even create spaces like the front line where just nobody can step foot, you know, for four kilometers on either side because the weapons are so deadly.
sentences.zh: 你只会制造一个完美的僵局。

sentences.en: And so how can you move forward in either way?
sentences.zh: 但我猜历史向我们展示了，至少在我对历史的理解中，事情可能不会那样发展。

sentences.en: And you just create a perfect stalemate.
sentences.zh: 过去每次我们看到武器方面的突破，往往意味着创造出了更具破坏性的武器。

sentences.en: But I guess history shows us, in my understanding of history at least, that that's not the way this will probably go.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我回想起了阿尔弗雷德·诺贝尔，他曾著名地认为炸药会终结战争。

sentences.en: And that every time in the past we've seen a breakthrough in weaponry, oftentimes it's just meant more devastating weapons get created.
sentences.zh: 当然，它只是制造出了威力更大、更致命的炸弹。

sentences.en: You know, I thought back to Alfred Nobel, who famously thought dynamite would end war.
sentences.zh: 感觉我们正在步入那样的未来。

sentences.en: And of course, it simply made more powerful, deadly bombs.
sentences.zh: 但我只是认为，坐在我们现在的位置，

sentences.en: And it feels like that is the kind of future that we are treading into.
sentences.zh: 在一个没有战争的地方，告诉那些正在制造武器以保卫家人和朋友、去对抗入侵者的人们停止这样做，因为这可能会让我们在未来变得不安全，是非常困难的。

sentences.en: But I just think that it's very hard to sit where we are, you know,
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: in a place that's not at war and tell people building these things that are weapons to defend their families and their friends who are going off to war against an invader to stop doing it because it could make us unsafe in the future.
sentences.zh: 即使是我采访过的一些非常反对自主武器、毕生致力于反对它们的伦理学家，他们也会摊开双手说，

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我真的无法反驳乌克兰人。

sentences.en: And even some of the ethicists I spoke with who are very opposed to have dedicated their careers to fighting against autonomous weapons, they would throw up their hands and say,
sentences.zh: 我采访过的一位正在制造自主无人机系统的乌克兰人说，你给我看一个假设的受害者，我给你看一个真实的死去的士兵，你知道，

sentences.en: well, I can't really argue with the Ukrainians.
sentences.zh: 一个现在不得不失去他而生活的家庭。

sentences.en: One of the Ukrainians I spoke with who's making autonomous drone systems said, you show me a hypothetical victim and I'll show you a real dead soldier and, you know,
sentences.zh: 这让你处于一个非常艰难的境地，因为你就像是在面对一列失控的火车。

sentences.en: a family that now has to live without him.
sentences.zh: 你不能从道德上争辩说人们应该停止制造保卫自己的东西。

sentences.en: And that leaves you in a very hard place because you're kind of have a what's sort of a runaway train.
sentences.zh: 然而，他们正在制造的东西基本上确保了一个比我们现在生活的世界危险得多的未来。

sentences.en: You can't morally argue for people to stop building things to defend themselves.
sentences.zh: 只要乌克兰的战争还在继续，我们就会看到更先进的系统被开发出来。

sentences.en: Yet what they're building basically secures a future that will be far more dangerous than the present that we live in.
sentences.zh: 我只是不知道我们如何避免一个拥有越来越强大、越来越自主武器的未来。

sentences.en: And as long as this war in Ukraine goes on, we are going to see more advanced systems get developed.
sentences.zh: 那真的很可怕。

sentences.en: And I just don't know how we avoid a future in which we have ever more powerful, ever more autonomous weapons.
sentences.zh: 保罗，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: And that's pretty scary.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。
